basis: Dmitry authorized this change over Telegram on 2026-09-24. He was told (29084) that the second critical review of VELDO-0058 found the change being checked could move the git reference the protected-file check uses to work out which files changed, so the check saw nothing changed, and asked whether policy_check.py (a protected file) may change so that the check takes the starting point the landing tool itself recorded instead of reading that reference; he answered 'Yes' (29085). The two paths are the protected_paths this commit changes. What it carries is an explicit BASE: unset, the push range is computed from the subject's refs exactly as before; when the installed-policy runner sets it to the lander's recorded watermark, every range read is BASE..HEAD, and a range Git cannot read is an error rather than an empty range. No other policy_check behavior changed.
